name: Fort Boyard: La Légende
storyline:
The port of La Rochelle... These old towers must hold many secrets; many prisoners must have died in these dungeons, many treasures must be buried in these foundations. But the treasure that interests me is not within these walls. It is well hidden in the middle of the Atlantic, on Fort Boyard.
Certain information in my possession leads me to believe that immense riches were hidden by Napoleon on the very site of the fort, just before his exile to Saint Helena. His ultimate goal was to finance his reconquest of Europe. But the emperor never returned to Saint Helena... Before me, other adventurers tried to seize this famous treasure, without success. But much information exists, particularly in the city of La Rochelle and on the surrounding islands. It is now up to me to find it, to show courage, cunning, and audacity... but the stakes are high.
Let the adventure begin!
summary: Fort Boyard: La Légende on PC is an FMV/Point n' Click game. Filmed at Fort Boyard and Inspired by the French TV Show of the same name, you must unravel the mysteries of the fort and find the treasure that Napoleon left behind before his exile.
